rows.name: customer_booking_timeline
statements:
-- SRK ELECTRONIC: expose a read-only, customer-owned booking status timeline.
-- The history table remains private to admins and service_role for direct table access.
-- Customers receive only status labels and timestamps for bookings they own.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.srk_get_customer_booking_timeline()
RETURNS TABLE (
  booking_id uuid,
  old_status text,
  new_status text,
  changed_at timestamptz
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT h.booking_id, h.old_status, h.new_status, h.changed_at
  FROM public.service_booking_status_history h
  INNER JOIN public.service_bookings b ON b.id = h.booking_id
  WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND b.customer_user_id = auth.uid()
  ORDER BY h.changed_at ASC
  LIMIT 1000;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.srk_get_customer_booking_timeline() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.srk_get_customer_booking_timeline() TO authenticated;

create table if not exists public.srk_service_categories (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  category_code text not null unique,
  category_name text not null unique,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_service_categories_code_format
    check (category_code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,49}$'),
  constraint srk_service_categories_name_nonempty
    check (length(btrim(category_name)) between 2 and 100)
);

create table if not exists public.srk_service_types (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  category_id uuid not null references public.srk_service_categories(id) on delete restrict,
  service_code text not null unique,
  service_name text not null,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_service_types_code_format
    check (service_code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,59}$'),
  constraint srk_service_types_name_nonempty
    check (length(btrim(service_name)) between 2 and 120),
  constraint srk_service_types_category_name_unique
    unique (category_id, service_name)
);

create table if not exists public.srk_service_skills (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  service_type_id uuid not null references public.srk_service_types(id) on delete restrict,
  skill_code text not null unique,
  skill_name text not null,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_service_skills_code_format
    check (skill_code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,79}$'),
  constraint srk_service_skills_name_nonempty
    check (length(btrim(skill_name)) between 2 and 150),
  constraint srk_service_skills_service_name_unique
    unique (service_type_id, skill_name)
);

create index if not exists srk_service_types_category_active_idx
  on public.srk_service_types(category_id, is_active, sort_order);

create index if not exists srk_service_skills_service_active_idx
  on public.srk_service_skills(service_type_id, is_active, sort_order);

alter table public.srk_service_categories enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_service_types enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_service_skills enable row level security;

insert into public.srk_service_categories
  (category_code, category_name, sort_order)
values
  ('electrician', 'Electrician', 1),
  ('plumber', 'Plumber', 2),
  ('painter', 'Painter', 3),
  ('ac_fridge_technician', 'AC + Fridge Technician', 4),
  ('motor_pump_technician', 'Motor & Pump Technician', 5),
  ('cooler_technician', 'Cooler Technician', 6)
on conflict (category_code) do update
set category_name = excluded.category_name,
    sort_order = excluded.sort_order,
    updated_at = now();

insert into public.srk_service_types
  (category_id, service_code, service_name, sort_order)
select c.id, v.service_code, v.service_name, v.sort_order
from public.srk_service_categories c
join (values
  ('ac_fridge_technician', 'ac_repair', 'AC Repair', 1),
  ('ac_fridge_technician', 'ac_installation', 'AC Installation', 2),
  ('ac_fridge_technician', 'fridge_repair', 'Fridge Repair', 3)
) as v(category_code, service_code, service_name, sort_order)

on conflict (service_code) do update
set category_id = excluded.category_id,
    service_name = excluded.service_name,

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_profiles (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null unique references auth.users(id) on delete restrict,
  worker_type text not null,
  worker_code text unique,
  full_name text not null,
  phone text not null,
  category_id uuid references public.srk_service_categories(id) on delete restrict,
  legacy_electrician_profile_id uuid unique
    references public.electrician_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  verification_status text not null default 'pending',
  is_active boolean not null default false,
  is_online boolean not null default false,
  father_name text,
  date_of_birth date,
  photo_path text,
  address text,
  state text,
  district text,
  pincode text,
  location_lat double precision,
  location_lng double precision,
  service_radius_km numeric(5,2) not null default 30,
  experience_years integer not null default 0,
  has_helper boolean not null default false,
  bank_account_last4 text,
  upi_id text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_worker_type_valid check (worker_type in ('technician','helper')),
  constraint srk_worker_verification_valid check (verification_status in ('pending','under_review','approved','rejected','suspended')),
  constraint srk_worker_name_valid check (length(btrim(full_name)) between 2 and 120),
  constraint srk_worker_phone_valid check (length(regexp_replace(phone,'[^0-9]','','g')) between 10 and 15),
  constraint srk_worker_radius_valid check (service_radius_km > 0 and service_radius_km <= 30),
  constraint srk_worker_experience_valid check (experience_years between 0 and 60),
  constraint srk_worker_location_lat_valid check (location_lat is null or location_lat between -90 and 90),
  constraint srk_worker_location_lng_valid check (location_lng is null or location_lng between -180 and 180),
  constraint srk_worker_legacy_link_only_technician
    check (legacy_electrician_profile_id is null or worker_type = 'technician')
);

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_skills (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  worker_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  skill_id uuid not null references public.srk_service_skills(id) on delete restrict,
  verification_status text not null default 'pending',
  reviewed_by uuid,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  admin_note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_worker_skill_status_valid check (verification_status in ('pending','approved','rejected')),
  constraint srk_worker_skill_unique unique(worker_id,skill_id),
  constraint srk_worker_skill_review_consistency
    check ((verification_status='pending' and reviewed_at is null) or
           (verification_status<>'pending' and reviewed_at is not null))
);

create index if not exists srk_worker_profiles_matching_idx
  on public.srk_worker_profiles(category_id, verification_status, is_active, is_online);

create index if not exists srk_worker_profiles_location_idx
  on public.srk_worker_profiles(location_lat, location_lng)
  where is_active and is_online and verification_status='approved';

create index if not exists srk_worker_skills_approved_idx
  on public.srk_worker_skills(skill_id, worker_id)
  where verification_status='approved';

alter table public.srk_worker_profiles enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_worker_skills enable row level security;

insert into public.srk_worker_profiles
  (user_id, worker_type, full_name, phone, category_id,
   legacy_electrician_profile_id, verification_status, is_active,
   state, district, pincode, location_lat, location_lng, experience_years)
select
  coalesce(ep.auth_user_id, ep.user_id),
  'technician',
  ep.display_name,
  ep.phone,
  c.id,
  ep.id,
  ep.verification_status,
  ep.active,
  ep.state,
  ep.district,
  ep.pincode,
  ep.location_lat,
  ep.location_lng,
  coalesce(ea.experience_years,0)
from public.electrician_profiles ep
left join public.electrician_applications ea on ea.id=ep.application_id
left join public.srk_service_categories c on c.category_code='electrician'
where coalesce(ep.auth_user_id,ep.user_id) is not null
on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

rows.name: create_multi_worker_booking_and_timer_tables
statements:
create table if not exists public.srk_booking_workers (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid not null references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  worker_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  worker_role text not null,
  assignment_status text not null default 'offered',
  assigned_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  accepted_at timestamptz,
  rejected_at timestamptz,
  released_at timestamptz,
  offered_by uuid,
  admin_note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_booking_worker_role_valid check (worker_role in ('technician','helper')),
  constraint srk_booking_worker_status_valid check (assignment_status in ('offered','accepted','rejected','assigned','working','paused','completed','cancelled','released')),
  constraint srk_booking_worker_unique unique(booking_id,worker_id)
);

create index if not exists srk_booking_workers_worker_status_idx
  on public.srk_booking_workers(worker_id,assignment_status);
create index if not exists srk_booking_workers_booking_idx
  on public.srk_booking_workers(booking_id,assignment_status);

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_work_sessions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_worker_id uuid not null references public.srk_booking_workers(id) on delete restrict,
  work_date date not null default (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date,
  session_status text not null default 'not_started',
  started_at timestamptz,
  ended_at timestamptz,
  last_resumed_at timestamptz,
  billable_seconds bigint not null default 0,
  pause_reason text,
  completion_note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_work_session_status_valid check (session_status in ('not_started','running','paused','completed','cancelled')),
  constraint srk_work_session_seconds_valid check (billable_seconds between 0 and 5184000),
  constraint srk_work_session_pause_reason_valid check (
    pause_reason is null or pause_reason in ('food_break','material','customer_permission','technical_problem','other')
  ),
  constraint srk_work_session_time_order check (
    (started_at is null or started_at <= coalesce(ended_at,'infinity'::timestamptz))
    and (last_resumed_at is null or started_at is not null)
  ),
  constraint srk_work_session_unique_day unique(booking_worker_id,work_date)
);

create unique index if not exists srk_one_running_session_per_worker
  on public.srk_worker_work_sessions(booking_worker_id)
  where session_status='running';

create index if not exists srk_worker_sessions_status_idx
  on public.srk_worker_work_sessions(session_status,work_date);

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_session_events (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_work_sessions(id) on delete restrict,
  event_type text not null,
  event_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  actor_user_id uuid,
  pause_reason text,
  note text,
  source text not null default 'app',
  idempotency_key text unique,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_worker_session_event_type_valid
    check (event_type in ('started','paused','resumed','completed','cancelled','offline_sync','admin_adjusted')),
  constraint srk_worker_session_event_pause_reason_valid
    check (pause_reason is null or pause_reason in ('food_break','material','customer_permission','technical_problem','other')),
  constraint srk_worker_session_event_source_valid
    check (source in ('app','admin','offline_sync','system'))
);

create index if not exists srk_worker_session_events_timeline_idx
  on public.srk_worker_session_events(session_id,event_at);

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_schedule_blocks (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  worker_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  booking_worker_id uuid references public.srk_booking_workers(id) on delete restrict,
  starts_at timestamptz not null,
  ends_at timestamptz not null,
  block_status text not null default 'reserved',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_worker_schedule_time_valid check (ends_at > starts_at),
  constraint srk_worker_schedule_status_valid check (block_status in ('reserved','confirmed','in_progress','completed','cancelled'))
);

create index if not exists srk_worker_schedule_worker_time_idx
  on public.srk_worker_schedule_blocks(worker_id,starts_at,ends_at)
  where block_status in ('reserved','confirmed','in_progress');

alter table public.srk_booking_workers enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_worker_work_sessions enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_worker_session_events enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_worker_schedule_blocks enable row level security;

create table if not exists public.srk_booking_final_bills (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid not null unique references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  bill_number text unique,
  service_amount numeric(12,2) not null default 0,
  materials_amount numeric(12,2) not null default 0,
  discount_amount numeric(12,2) not null default 0,
  tax_amount numeric(12,2) not null default 0,
  total_amount numeric(12,2) generated always as (service_amount + materials_amount - discount_amount + tax_amount) stored,
  status text not null default 'draft',
  prepared_at timestamptz,
  approved_at timestamptz,
  approved_by uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_final_bill_amounts_nonnegative check (
    service_amount >= 0 and materials_amount >= 0 and discount_amount >= 0 and tax_amount >= 0
  ),
  constraint srk_final_bill_discount_cap check (discount_amount <= service_amount + materials_amount),
  constraint srk_final_bill_status_valid check (status in ('draft','issued','approved','disputed','void'))
);

create table if not exists public.srk_booking_final_bill_items (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  bill_id uuid not null references public.srk_booking_final_bills(id) on delete restrict,
  item_type text not null,
  description text not null,
  quantity numeric(10,2) not null default 1,
  unit text not null default 'unit',
  unit_price numeric(12,2) not null,
  line_total numeric(12,2) generated always as (quantity * unit_price) stored,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_bill_item_type_valid check (item_type in ('service','labour','material','discount','other')),
  constraint srk_bill_item_quantity_valid check (quantity > 0),
  constraint srk_bill_item_price_valid check (unit_price >= 0)
);

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_earnings (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid not null references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  booking_worker_id uuid not null unique references public.srk_booking_workers(id) on delete restrict,
  worker_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  worker_role text not null,
  bill_id uuid references public.srk_booking_final_bills(id) on delete restrict,
  billable_seconds bigint not null default 0,
  gross_service_earning numeric(12,2) not null,
  company_commission_rate numeric(5,2) not null default 15.00,
  company_commission numeric(12,2) not null,
  net_earning numeric(12,2) not null,
  payout_status text not null default 'pending',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_worker_earning_role_valid check (worker_role in ('technician','helper')),
  constraint srk_worker_earning_seconds_valid check (billable_seconds between 0 and 5184000),
  constraint srk_worker_earning_commission_valid check (company_commission_rate=15.00),
  constraint srk_worker_earning_amounts_valid check (
    gross_service_earning >= 0 and company_commission >= 0 and net_earning >= 0
    and company_commission <= gross_service_earning
    and net_earning = gross_service_earning - company_commission
  ),
  constraint srk_worker_earning_payout_status_valid check (payout_status in ('pending','available','partially_paid','paid','held','adjusted'))
);

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_wallet_ledger (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  worker_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  booking_id uuid references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  earning_id uuid references public.srk_worker_earnings(id) on delete restrict,
  entry_type text not null,
  amount numeric(12,2) not null,
  balance_effect numeric(12,2) not null,
  description text,
  reference_id text,
  idempotency_key text not null unique,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_worker_wallet_entry_type_valid check (
    entry_type in ('earning','commission','cash_commission_due','payout_requested','payout_paid','refund_adjustment','admin_adjustment','hold','release')
  )
);

create index if not exists srk_worker_wallet_ledger_worker_time_idx
  on public.srk_worker_wallet_ledger(worker_id,created_at desc);

create table if not exists public.srk_worker_payout_requests (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  payout_code text unique,
  worker_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  requested_amount numeric(12,2) not null,
  approved_amount numeric(12,2),
  status text not null default 'requested',
  payment_method text,
  payment_reference text,
  admin_note text,
  requested_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  paid_at timestamptz,
  reviewed_by uuid,
  constraint srk_worker_payout_amount_valid check (requested_amount > 0 and (approved_amount is null or approved_amount > 0)),
  constraint srk_worker_payout_status_valid check (status in ('requested','under_review','approved','rejected','paid','failed','cancelled')),
  constraint srk_worker_payout_method_valid check (payment_method is null or payment_method in ('upi','bank_transfer','phonepe','other'))
);

create index if not exists srk_worker_payout_worker_status_idx
  on public.srk_worker_payout_requests(worker_id,status,requested_at desc);

create table if not exists public.srk_technician_booking_cycle (
  technician_id uuid primary key references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  completed_booking_count bigint not null default 0,
  last_completed_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_technician_cycle_count_nonnegative check (completed_booking_count >= 0)
);

create table if not exists public.srk_technician_booking_sequence (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  technician_id uuid not null references public.srk_worker_profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  booking_id uuid not null references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  sequence_number bigint not null,
  payment_method text,
  completed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_technician_booking_sequence_unique unique(technician_id,sequence_number),
  constraint srk_technician_booking_once unique(technician_id,booking_id),
  constraint srk_technician_cycle_payment_method check (payment_method is null or payment_method in ('cash','online'))
);

create table if not exists public.srk_booking_payment_evidence (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid not null references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  submitted_by uuid not null,
  payer_role text not null,
  payment_method text not null,
  amount numeric(12,2) not null,
  reference_number text,
  evidence_storage_path text,
  verification_status text not null default 'pending',
  verified_by uuid,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_payment_evidence_role_valid check (payer_role in ('customer','technician','helper','admin')),
  constraint srk_payment_evidence_method_valid check (payment_method in ('cash','upi','card','online','bank_transfer')),
  constraint srk_payment_evidence_amount_valid check (amount > 0),
  constraint srk_payment_evidence_status_valid check (verification_status in ('pending','verified','rejected','disputed'))
);

create index if not exists srk_booking_payment_evidence_booking_idx
  on public.srk_booking_payment_evidence(booking_id,created_at desc);

create table if not exists public.srk_booking_payment_disputes (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid not null references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  raised_by uuid not null,
  raised_by_role text not null,
  dispute_type text not null,
  description text not null,
  status text not null default 'open',
  assigned_admin uuid,
  resolution text,
  resolved_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_payment_dispute_role_valid check (raised_by_role in ('customer','technician','helper')),
  constraint srk_payment_dispute_type_valid check (dispute_type in ('not_paid','cash_not_received','amount_mismatch','online_payment_failed','refund_delay','other')),
  constraint srk_payment_dispute_status_valid check (status in ('open','under_review','awaiting_evidence','resolved','rejected'))
);

create index if not exists srk_booking_payment_disputes_status_idx
  on public.srk_booking_payment_disputes(status,created_at desc);

create table if not exists public.srk_booking_admin_changes (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  admin_user_id uuid not null,
  entity_type text not null,
  entity_id uuid,
  action text not null,
  reason text not null,
  old_values jsonb,
  new_values jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists srk_booking_admin_changes_booking_idx
  on public.srk_booking_admin_changes(booking_id,created_at desc);

alter table public.srk_booking_final_bills enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_booking_final_bill_items enable row level security;

create table if not exists public.srk_skill_levels (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  category_id uuid not null references public.srk_service_categories(id) on delete restrict,
  level_code text not null,
  level_name text not null,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_skill_level_category_code_unique unique(category_id,level_code),
  constraint srk_skill_level_name_valid check(length(btrim(level_name)) between 2 and 100)
);

create table if not exists public.srk_service_rates (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  category_id uuid not null references public.srk_service_categories(id) on delete restrict,
  service_type_id uuid references public.srk_service_types(id) on delete restrict,
  skill_level_id uuid not null references public.srk_skill_levels(id) on delete restrict,
  technician_hourly_rate numeric(10,2),
  helper_hourly_rate numeric(10,2),
  rate_status text not null default 'draft',
  effective_from timestamptz not null default now(),
  effective_to timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  created_by uuid,
  constraint srk_service_rate_status_valid check(rate_status in ('draft','approved','retired')),
  constraint srk_service_rate_amounts_valid check(
    (technician_hourly_rate is null or technician_hourly_rate>=0)
    and (helper_hourly_rate is null or helper_hourly_rate>=0)
  ),
  constraint srk_service_rate_effective_valid check(effective_to is null or effective_to>effective_from)
);

create unique index if not exists srk_service_rates_active_unique
  on public.srk_service_rates(category_id,coalesce(service_type_id,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid),skill_level_id)
  where rate_status='approved' and effective_to is null;

insert into public.srk_skill_levels(category_id,level_code,level_name,sort_order)
select c.id,v.level_code,v.level_name,v.sort_order
from public.srk_service_categories c
join (values
 ('electrician','basic','Basic',1),
 ('electrician','residential_office','Residential/Office Wiring',2),
 ('electrician','factory_industrial_expert','Factory/Industrial Wiring Expert',3),
 ('electrician','master_electrician','Master Electrician',4),
 ('plumber','basic','Basic',1),
 ('plumber','expert','Expert',2),
 ('plumber','master_industrial','Master/Industrial',3),
 ('painter','basic','Basic',1),
 ('painter','expert','Expert',2),
 ('painter','master','Master',3),
 ('ac_fridge_technician','ac_technician','AC Technician',1),
 ('ac_fridge_technician','fridge_technician','Fridge Technician',2),
 ('motor_pump_technician','basic','Basic',1),
 ('motor_pump_technician','expert','Expert',2),
 ('motor_pump_technician','master','Master',3),
 ('cooler_technician','basic','Basic',1),
 ('cooler_technician','expert','Expert',2),
 ('cooler_technician','master','Master',3)
) v(category_code,level_code,level_name,sort_order)
on c.category_code=v.category_code
on conflict(category_id,level_code) do update set level_name=excluded.level_name,sort_order=excluded.sort_order;

insert into public.srk_service_rates(category_id,service_type_id,skill_level_id,technician_hourly_rate,helper_hourly_rate,rate_status)
select c.id,null,l.id,v.tech_rate,v.helper_rate,'approved'
from (values
 ('plumber','basic',100::numeric,50::numeric),
 ('plumber','expert',150::numeric,75::numeric),
 ('plumber','master_industrial',225::numeric,100::numeric),
 ('electrician','factory_industrial_expert',300::numeric,125::numeric),
 ('electrician','master_electrician',700::numeric,200::numeric)
) v(category_code,level_code,tech_rate,helper_rate)
join public.srk_service_categories c on c.category_code=v.category_code
join public.srk_skill_levels l on l.category_id=c.id and l.level_code=v.level_code
on conflict do nothing;

insert into public.srk_service_rates(category_id,service_type_id,skill_level_id,technician_hourly_rate,helper_hourly_rate,rate_status)
select c.id,s.id,l.id,250,150,'approved'
from public.srk_service_categories c
join public.srk_service_types s on s.category_id=c.id and s.service_code in ('ac_repair','ac_installation')
join public.srk_skill_levels l on l.category_id=c.id and l.level_code='ac_technician'
where c.category_code='ac_fridge_technician'
on conflict do nothing;

alter table public.srk_skill_levels enable row level security;
alter table public.srk_service_rates enable row level security;
